register.labelZh: EVEN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: even out 可以描述道路變得平坦、速度變得穩定,或數字變得較有規律。；even something out 可以用來描述平均分配工作、付款、重量、顏色和泥土等日常事物。；even something up 可以表示有人令雙方更公平,或把比分追平。；這些表達可以出現在旅遊、工作、金錢、運動、烹飪和日常對話中。
register.summaryEn: Even out can describe a road becoming flatter, a speed becoming steady or numbers becoming more regular. Even something out can describe balancing work, payments, weight, colour, soil and other everyday things. Even something up can show that somebody has made two sides fairer or brought the scores level. These expressions can appear in travel, work, money, sport, cooking and everyday conversations.
